pages.text: The $(item)Nano Saber$() is a powerful melee weapon you’ll be able to unlock once you reach late $(5)EV$(). Simply use $(item)$(k:key.sneak) + $(k:key.use)$() to activate the $(thing)bzzzzz mode$().

The $(item)Certus Mechanism$() is used to craft $(5)EV$()-tier guns. A lot of these weapons use ammo that requires Certus Quartz. The moon has huge veins of it, or you can set up an infinite supply via $(l:the_moon/regolith)Lunar Regolith$().

pages.title: Shoulder-Fired Field Gun
pages.text: Want to walk around with a tank cannon? This gun is slow, heavy, but packs a massive punch.

pages.title: Advanced Rifles
pages.text: These are good balanced weapons if you don't know what to pick.

pages.title: Grenade Launcher
pages.text: If you ever finding yourself fighting large groups of enemies at once, this may be your ticket.

pages.title: Advanced Pistols and SMGs
pages.text: Want to shoot fast? These guns are perfect.

pages.title: Tungstensteel Space Suit
pages.text: With this next space suit, you'll be able to survive both the $(b)coldest$() and the $(c)hottest$() environments that space can throw at you! It will be required to stop you from immediately combusting as soon as you set foot on $(6)Venus$() and $(5)Mercury$().$(br)As a bonus, it also comes with some extra armor and air capacity!

The $(item)Reinforced Shield$() deals damage back to attackers, like the Thorns enchant in normal Minecraft. Its crafting materials can be found from $(l:mars/mars_fauna#cruncher)Crunchers$() and $(l:mars/mars_fauna#eater)Eaters$().

The $(item)Corrupted Shield$() randomly teleports attackers, which can be good for keeping them away from you... but it can also teleport them behind you. You can get the teeth from the $(l:mars/mars_fauna#endermen)Cave Endermen$() under the surface of Mars.

The $(item)Ricoshield$() absorbs an amount of damage before releasing a shockwave, hurting anything else nearby. You can find the $(item)Kinetic Core$() as a rare drop from the $(l:mars/mars_fauna#quake)hostile golems$() in the Martian caves.
